reviews.title: Big delay / complaint
reviews.text: It was worst airline ; delay in departure from Erbil to Istanbul more than 5 hours making me to lose the connecting flight & I lost 500 US $ & they refuse to compensate ! I don't advise at all
reviews.author: wisam

reviews.title: Excellent Service by this low-cost Airline in the region.
reviews.text: My Journey through NJF-BOM was quite joyful compared to the price I paid. The Ticket price was cheaper than other airlines flying this route. But within this price, I received a quality service, dinner and refreshments FREE in a low-cost airline was really surprise for me. A young on-board staff with full energy, smiling and welcoming gestures.
reviews.author: MFH

reviews.title: excellent service provider
reviews.text: it is an excellent airline with their warm services starting from the ticketing and check in then on board the crew where so nice and the aircraft extremely clean
reviews.author: Basheer al-shabbani

reviews.title: Bad Flight Report
reviews.text: Bad airplane, old, unclean, out of service, dangerous, unsafe, bad take off and landing, feels like you are outside of the plane on the clouds not inside due to the loud sounds coming out of the engines and fans! Seats are literally made for toddlers not adults! Small and extremely uncomfortable. So,, in general, 0 out of 10! There is nothing good about it at all. Thanks anyway we landed on the right airport, we thought the pilot was heading somewhere else, I think he was asleep or something.. It was the first time and the last time we booked our flight with FlyBaghdad, will never make such a mistake again..
reviews.author: Traveller

reviews.title: Istanbul Business Trip
reviews.text: Budget airline with very affordable prices. Good level of service onboard the aircraft. Departed on time, arrived at destination early.
reviews.author: Mark C

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: My flight was canceled and we were informed that our flight would be next Thursday instead of Tuesday without any further information, we had to rebook hotel for three days. They didn’t refund anything.
reviews.author: Taymor Yasir

reviews.title: not good airlines
reviews.text: funny how their main title is (Pay less and travel more ) but you will be paying more for the worst services ever ! , they have like only 2 or 3 airplanes , DON'T even get me started on the holiday season where they upraise their prices like a luxury airline ! bottom line is the plane is out of services but they rent and used it anyway ... dangerous , always get delayed from one to four hours per flight ... bad seating , not clean, and yes unfriendly staff.
